title: Milestone 1 — who owns the retry decision?
subtitle: Concrete proposal: two ReportNotReady failures, then success with attempts=3. Arrows are calls or outcomes; the callback remains outside the library boundary.

actors.title: Report viewer
body: Chooses safe failure types and a total attempt limit. Receives the report or the original failure.

actors.title: RetryPolicy
body: Proposed: validate and freeze attempts=3 and retry_on=(ReportNotReady,).

actors.title: retry executor
body: Proposed: owns a local attempt count; invokes callback and admits eligible retries.

actors.title: load_report
body: Proposed example: two temporary failures, then the report; owns readiness.

events: read validated attempt limit and eligible exception types

notes: Limit 2: after failure #2, the executor re-raises that failure; no third invocation occurs.
PermissionError: does not match retry_on; it escapes to the viewer after the first call.
The library bounds call count. It does not make effects idempotent or interrupt a callback.
